text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon and her team come<n>together to
overcome the target times<n>Ms. Kashimoto set for
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And from what I can see, they've<n>come a long
way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's time for round five of<n>the Unity Cup!
The day of the final<n>showdown against Team Zenith
has<n>come at long last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Team Zenith's overwhelming<n>presence,
Taiki Shuttle and the others<n>are undaunted and
determined to win.<n>The races are about to begin...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The team pumps itself up with a<n>rowdy cheer.
Happy Hoppers, let's<n>go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The team pumps itself up with a<n>rowdy cheer.
Sunny Runners, let's<n>go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The team pumps itself up with a<n>rowdy cheer.
Carrot Pudding, let's<n>go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The team pumps itself up with a<n>rowdy cheer. Blue
Bloom, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The team pumps itself up with a<n>rowdy cheer. Team
Carrot, let's go!
